remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully updated, move-in ready home, blending modern comfort with inviting charm. This stylish residence features three bedrooms, two full remodeled bathrooms, and durable laminate flooring throughout. The gourmet kitchen boasts elegant quartz countertops and sleek finishes, while the upgraded bathrooms highlight modern glass shower enclosures and a classic pedestal sink in one of the bathrooms. A cozy den features a warm fireplace, complemented by a unique interior atrium that fills space with abundant natural light.
